title: Substrates bind to residues lining the ring of asymmetrically engaged bacterial proteasome activator Bpa.
authors: von Rosen, Tatjana; Zdanowicz, Rafal; El Hadeg, Yasser; Afanasyev, Pavel; Boehringer, Daniel; Leitner, Alexander; Glockshuber, Rudi; Weber-Ban, Eilika
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细菌蛋白酶体激活因子Bpa与底物HspR的结合及冷冻电镜结构，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白互作，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Mycobacteria harbor a proteasome that was acquired by Actinobacteria through horizontal gene transfer and that supports the persistence of the human pathogen Mycobacterium tuberculosis within host macrophages. The core particle of the proteasome (20S CP) associates with ring-shaped activator complexes to degrade protein substrates. One of these is the bacterial proteasome activator Bpa that stimulates the ATP-independent proteasomal degradation of the heat shock repressor HspR. In this study, we determine the cryogenic electron microscopy 3D reconstruction of the complex between Bpa and its natural substrate HspR at 4.1 A global resolution. The resulting maps allow us to identify regions of Bpa that interact with HspR. Using structure-guided site-directed mutagenesis and in vitro biochemical assays, we confirm the importance of the identified residues for Bpa-mediated substrate recruitment and subsequent proteasomal degradation. Additionally, we show that the dodecameric Bpa ring associates asymmetrically with the heptameric alpha-rings of the 20S CP, adopting a conformation resembling a hinged lid, while still engaging all seven docking sites on the proteasome.
abstract_zh: 分枝杆菌携带一种蛋白酶体，该蛋白酶体通过水平基因转移从放线菌获得，并支持人类病原体结核分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis）在宿主巨噬细胞内的持久存在。蛋白酶体的核心颗粒（20S CP）与环状激活复合物结合以降解蛋白质底物。其中之一是细菌蛋白酶体激活因子Bpa，它刺激热休克阻遏蛋白HspR的ATP非依赖性蛋白酶体降解。在本研究中，我们确定了Bpa与其天然底物HspR复合物的冷冻电镜三维重建结构，全局分辨率为4.1 Å。所得图谱使我们能够识别Bpa中与HspR相互作用的区域。通过结构引导的定点突变和体外生化实验，我们确认了所识别残基在Bpa介导的底物招募及后续蛋白酶体降解中的重要性。此外，我们展示了十二聚体Bpa环与20S CP的七聚体α环不对称结合，采用类似铰链盖的构象，同时仍占据蛋白酶体上的所有七个对接位点。
